title: Frequently Asked Questions
seoTitle: FAQ | Solar Products, SEO Tracking & Inquiry System | Callsun
metaDescription: Frequently asked questions about Callsun solar modules, system packages, B2B website content, downloads, Google Ads tracking and inquiry system integration.
h1: Frequently asked questions for B2B solar buyers and website operators.

hero.description: Use this FAQ page to answer common buyer questions, explain operational readiness and reduce sales friction before visitors request documents or quotes.

items.question: Who is Callsun built for?
items.answer: Callsun.com is positioned for B2B distributors, dealers and EPC installers who need solar modules, storage packages and repeatable project references.

items.question: Which product lines are currently structured on the website?
items.answer: The current structure includes standard 450W, 580W and 620W modules, compact custom modules, grid-tied storage packages and off-grid system packages.

items.question: Can product images and datasheets be replaced later?
items.answer: Yes. Product, solution, case and resource images are CMS-editable. Datasheets and certificates can be uploaded to the downloads collection once official customer files are provided.

items.question: Can the website support SEO content operations?
items.answer: Yes. Products, solutions, applications, blog posts, cases and support pages are CMS-driven and include editable SEO title, meta description, H1, keywords, OG image and image alt fields.

items.question: Can we connect Google Ads and GA4 later?
items.answer: Yes. GTM, GA4, Google Ads conversion IDs and dataLayer events are reserved. Scripts load only after Cookie Consent and after account IDs are provided.

items.question: Does the site support independent landing pages?
items.answer: Yes. Landing pages are CMS-managed and can be used for future SEM campaigns with campaign, ad group, UTM and RFQ tracking fields.

items.question: Is the inquiry system final?
items.answer: Not yet. The current phase includes inquiry UI, UTM fields, mock backend and event tracking. The backend can later connect to HubSpot, Feishu Bitable, Cloudflare D1 or another CRM.

items.question: What inquiry fields are already captured?
items.answer: The contact form can capture name, company, email, phone, inquiry type, application, buyer role, timeline, market, project size, document needs, message, UTM, referrer and landing page.

finalCta.title: Still have a project-specific question?
finalCta.description: Send the product, application, market and document requirement. Callsun can route the inquiry to sales or technical support.
